newsitem.title: UK: WESTERN BULK SHIPPING EGM CALLED FOR AUGUST 22.
newsitem.headline: WESTERN BULK SHIPPING EGM CALLED FOR AUGUST 22.

text.p: Western Bulk Shipping, a Norwegian shipping company, has called an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders for August 22.
Western Bulk was responding to a request from Sjoinvest, a shipping investment fund which controls a 26 percent stake in the firm.
In a statement to the Oslo bourse, directors of Western Bulk said it was right that the company's shareholder structure is reflected on its board of directors.
Sjoinvest has said it intends to propose election of a new, but as yet unnamed, board of directors.
Sjoinvest's proposals have the support of Norwegian engineering group Kvaerner, which holds 18 percent of Western Bulk. --Reuter Shipping Desk + 44 171 542 4087/4012. Fax 5017.
